items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's identification of Ernie Stevens, nor does the interviewee mention Ernie Stevens in their own speech.

ctx.x: Regular open pavilion, just for the little stuff. Top on it, shed over it, you know. And Mr. Foster had the ballroom right across from the... Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
That's Mr. Stevens. What's his name again? Ernie Stevens?
Yeah, Ernie Stevens, yeah, right here. And that's his two sons. They were in the service, too. And this here is Emil Christian and Tony Parenti.
